_about: Childhood events, ages 0-12. Text is a subject-less past-tense phrase. trait: L light, D dark, N neutral, R random, X exotic. bias: low/high favors poorer/richer homes. follow: name of a table in special.json to roll for more detail. Original content written for DCUGen.

events.text: Got lost at a {state fair|crowded stadium|downtown parade} for six hours and was found calmly helping another lost kid.
Broke an arm jumping off a garage roof with a bedsheet tied on as a cape.
Was the kid who brought home every stray animal, including one memorable raccoon.
Taught {themself} to read from comic books and cereal boxes before kindergarten.
Was diagnosed with severe asthma and spent a lot of recess watching from the window.
Was bullied relentlessly by {npc} for a whole school year.

person.who: {npc}, the childhood bully who made {name}'s life miserable
person.status: Still lives in {hometown}; acts as if nothing happened.

events.text: Stood up to the neighborhood bully to protect a smaller kid and got a black eye for it.
Caught shoplifting candy and was marched home by a store owner; never forgot the look on {their} {parent}'s face.
Won a citywide spelling bee and was briefly famous in the local paper.
Nearly drowned in a {quarry|river|public pool} and was pulled out by a stranger who vanished before anyone got a name.
Witnessed a costumed hero stop a runaway {train|tanker truck|crane} a block away and talked about nothing else for a year.
events.motive: Has wanted to be like the heroes ever since a childhood rescue.

events.text: Was trapped for hours in the rubble when a villain's attack collapsed {their} school.

complication.text: Claustrophobic since being buried in rubble as a child.

events.text: Spent every weekend at {their} {parent}'s workplace and picked up the trade.
Moved {three|four|five} times in two years and learned not to get attached to friends.
Had a best friend named {first} who moved away without saying goodbye.

person.who: {npc}, a childhood best friend who moved away suddenly
person.status: Recently reached out on social media after twenty years of silence.

events.text: Built a working radio from junkyard parts at age {9|10|11}.
Was hospitalized for months with a mysterious fever that left doctors baffled.
events.hook: The fever's bloodwork is still on file somewhere, and someone has requested it.

events.text: Spent summers with a grandparent who taught old stories, card tricks and how to tell when an adult was lying.
Was home alone when burglars broke in and hid in a closet until they left.
Joined a youth {soccer|hockey|baseball|swim} team and turned out to be a natural.
Took up martial arts at a strip-mall dojo run by {npc}.

person.who: {npc}, the patient martial-arts teacher from the strip-mall dojo
person.status: Still teaching, slower now, and still asks about {name}.

events.text: Watched {their} family get evicted, belongings piled on the curb in the rain.
events.regret: Never being able to fix things for the family when it mattered.

events.text: Got {their} first library card and practically lived in the stacks.
Was a child model for {company} ads and hated every minute.
Accidentally set the kitchen on fire making a birthday breakfast for {their} {parent}.
Was kidnapped for ransom and held in a basement for three days before police found {them}.
events.secret: Recognized one kidnapper's voice years later and never told anyone.

events.text: Found an odd glowing stone in a creek bed and kept it in a sock drawer for years.
events.hook: The stone from the creek has started glowing again.

events.text: Had an imaginary friend who, the family swears, moved things around the house.
Won a science fair with a project the judges assumed a parent had built.
Was held back a grade and spent years feeling stupid until a teacher noticed {they_were} dyslexic.
Was the only kid in class who wasn't invited to {npc}'s birthday party.
Lived through a {flood|tornado|wildfire|hurricane} that wiped out half the town.
Got a puppy that became {their} constant shadow for the next twelve years.
Was a choir soloist at {church}.
Picked locks for fun after finding an old locksmith's kit at a yard sale.
Spent a year in a full-body cast after a car accident and read everything in reach.
Got caught in a gang shootout on the way home from school and hid under a mail truck.
Was sent to an exclusive summer camp where the other kids' parents were senators and CEOs.
Ran a lemonade stand that turned into a small, slightly illegal snack empire at school.
Was raised for a while by a neighbor while {their} {parent} was in the hospital.

person.who: {npc}, the neighbor who took {name} in during a family crisis

events.text: Saw something enormous move under the surface of the {lake|harbor|reservoir} one night and was never believed.
Was mistaken for another child by a man in a dark car who said, 'You're not the one,' and drove away.
events.hook: The man in the dark car has been seen near {name}'s home.

events.text: Got a hand-me-down computer and taught {themself} to code from library books.
Learned to cook because nobody else in the house would.
Was the best hide-and-seek player on the block; nobody ever found the spot.
Saw {their} {parent} hit by a drunk driver and survive, barely.
Started stealing food from the corner store to feed younger siblings.
Was chosen to present flowers to a visiting hero at a city ceremony, and the hero remembered {their} name.

person.who: {hero}, the costumed hero who once shook a small child's hand at a ceremony
person.status: Active; still remembers {name}, which is either touching or alarming.

events.text: Had night terrors about a burning city years before anyone had heard of the villain who would try to burn it.
Won a scholarship to a private school and was the poorest kid there by a mile.
Was teased for a stutter until learning to talk around it with jokes.
Climbed everything: trees, fences, water towers, once the school roof during an assembly.
Was hit by a car while chasing a ball and walked away without a scratch, to everyone's confusion.
Lost {their} beloved grandparent and spent a summer not speaking.
Joined the Scouts and collected badges with grim determination.
Was the go-between for parents who refused to speak to each other.
Rescued {sibling} from a house fire and has the burn scar on one arm to prove it.
Blamed {sibling} for a broken heirloom and let the punishment stand.
events.regret: Letting {sibling} take the blame for something {name} did as a kid.

events.text: Learned chess from an old man in the park and beat him by age {9|10|11}.
Spent a year in a hospital ward for children with rare blood disorders, alongside kids who did not all go home.
Followed {their} {parent} on a dangerous late-night errand and saw something {they_were} never supposed to see.
events.secret: Knows about a crime a parent committed and has kept quiet about it for years.

events.text: Was a stage kid in a traveling theater troupe for two summers.
Was fascinated by the night sky and kept a notebook of every 'shooting star' that didn't behave like one.
